hero.name: Siddharajsinh Chauhan

hero.resumeSummary: Full-stack software engineer with {{years}}+ years building ecommerce web applications for USA, UK and European clients, mainly meal delivery and online retail. Primary developer on 5+ production sites, building about 90% of each: storefront, cart, checkout, payments, subscriptions and order processing. React.js, TypeScript and Next.js on the frontend; Node.js/Express.js, Python/FastAPI and ASP.NET Core on the backend. Ship production code daily with AI coding tools (Claude Code), reviewing every change against real requirements.

paragraphs: I'm a Full-Stack Software Engineer with {{years}}+ years of experience building and scaling production web applications. My passion lies in crafting intuitive, performant, and beautiful solutions — from pixel-perfect React UIs to resilient Node.js backends.

React and TypeScript are my primary tools of choice. I've spent the last few years building complex SPAs, optimizing performance, integrating payment gateways like Stripe, and shipping features that real users rely on every day.
Outside of coding, I enjoy hiking, playing cricket, reading tech blogs, and contributing to open-source. I thrive in collaborative Agile environments and I'm always excited to take on new challenges.

description: Contract lead engineer for full-stack ecommerce work in React.js, TypeScript, Next.js and Node.js, owning architecture and releases.
Work directly with clients and stakeholders to define requirements, scope the work and keep releases on schedule.
Lead developer on MightyMeals for 4+ years (React.js, FastAPI, WooCommerce): architecture, releases, payments, subscriptions and auth.

Primary developer on 5+ production ecommerce sites for USA, UK and European clients, building about 90% of each (storefront, cart, checkout, order processing) in React.js, TypeScript, Next.js and Node.js with Python/FastAPI or ASP.NET Core backends.
Cut wrong delivery addresses at checkout by rebuilding address forms on the Google Maps Places API with reworked autofill logic.
Accelerated page loads by 10X and shrank bundle size by 45% through code splitting and lazy loading, and re-architected complex forms into reusable components with centralized Redux state.
Built responsive client websites with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and jQuery, and supported ASP.NET MVC backends in C# and SQL Server.

testimonials.name: Ravi Patel
testimonials.quote: Sid turned around a complex Stripe + Authorize.net integration in record time. His TypeScript is clean, his PRs are well-structured, and he always asks the right clarifying questions before diving in.

testimonials.name: Anita Sharma
testimonials.quote: Working with Sid on the React UI was a pleasure. He translates Figma comps pixel-perfectly and proactively suggests micro-animations that genuinely improve the UX rather than just adding noise.

testimonials.name: Mihir Desai
testimonials.quote: Sid's Node/Express APIs are consistently well-thought-out — proper error handling, sensible status codes, and he writes integration tests without being asked. A developer you can actually depend on.

testimonials.name: Priya Mehta
testimonials.quote: He shipped a Google Maps autocomplete feature end-to-end in 3 days with zero reported bugs. Strong self-starter who doesn't need his hand held through ambiguous requirements.

testimonials.name: Jatin Vora
testimonials.quote: We built a multi-tenant SaaS dashboard together. Sid's performance optimisations — bundle splitting, lazy routes, memo boundaries — cut initial load from 4.2 s to under 1.3 s. Impressive stuff.

testimonials.name: Sneha Kapoor
testimonials.quote: His code quality means our QA cycles are shorter. Fewer regressions, self-documenting components, and he actually writes unit tests alongside features. A rare find in the frontend world.

projects.title: MightyMeals
projects.description: $18M USD annual revenue meal delivery business serving 27 states and DC with a 150+ meal menu, rated 4.8/5 on Google from 800+ reviews. Thousands of transactions a week on a headless React.js storefront over WooCommerce via REST APIs.
resumeBullets: $18M USD annual revenue meal delivery business serving 27 states and DC with a 150+ meal menu, rated 4.8/5 on Google from 800+ reviews. Thousands of transactions a week on a headless React.js storefront over WooCommerce via REST APIs.
Ownership: wrote 82% of the storefront's 2,900+ commits over 4.5 years, including 96% of Autoship and 89% of checkout code.
Autoship (Order Planner): built the subscription system for weekly repeat orders charged to saved cards at Monday and Thursday noon ET deadlines, with change, skip, pause and cancel from My Account.
Payments: Authorize.net and Stripe with saved cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, gift cards and combined coupon and gift card redemption.
Growth: Mighty Points (1 point per $1), $120/$50 referrals, affiliate tracking, Google sign-in and a 15% ID.me-verified military discount.
AI-assisted delivery: rebuilt 20+ Elementor pages as static React in three days with Claude Code (17 commits, ~18k lines).
AI prototype: GPT function-calling nutrition assistant (Next.js 16) with a tool loop over the live menu API and USDA FoodData Central.
